scope: Known PRBS15 laboratory test pattern. Labeling and phase learned on 2048 prefix bits; error counts evaluated on a disjoint suffix. No protocol, CRC or authenticated emitter. Development regression, not a reserved corpus.

prbs15.reference: PRBS15, period 32767; canonical recurrence b[n]=b[n-14] XOR b[n-15], all-one initial state; both time directions searched
prbs15.scope: known test-pattern consistency only; no CRC, protocol identification or authenticated transmitter
prbs15.fit_scope: labeling, sequence direction and phase selected only on acquisition prefix; evaluation suffix never used for selection
prbs15.label_mapping_method: per-label bit majority per PN phase; retain bijective tables
prbs15.hash_convention: all analyzed bits packed MSB-first; zero padding to complete the final byte
